title: Rav Acha son of Rav Ketina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Yevamot 66a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.66a.2) he relates a case of a woman who was half a maidservant, etc. The statement is repeated in [Gittin 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.38a.18) in the name of Rav Chanina son of Rav Ketina, and [Gittin 43b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.43b.5) in the name of Rav Huna bar Ketina. He is also mentioned in [Zevachim 53a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.53a.9).[^2]

notes.text: The consulted passages name Acha in Yevamot and Zevachim, Chanina in Gittin 38a, and Huna in Gittin 43b. The two Gittin passages and the Yevamot passage report Rabbi Yitzchak.

The Gittin 38a account continues at [Gittin 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.38b.1). [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=331&lang=en) names Rav Acha bar Rav Ketina for Yevamot and Zevachim and explicitly records Rabbi Yitzchak as the authority quoted in Yevamot.
